project.name: osgi/doctor/doctor-port-test
project.description: The -test fragment of doctor-port, on the jgiven-probe-test model: a Fragment-Host attached to the doctor-port bundle, sharing its classloader so its test classes run IN-CONTAINER against the port's own world (not the bare-JVM flat classpath that produced the ReferralReplies Maven cycle). It carries, in src/main so they land in the fragment: (1) the value-type tests (MedicalRecord, ConsultationReport serialization/expectations, DoctorRecords, efficacy) that the flat classpath forced to be parked in seed-master HOST; (2) the shared model fixtures (ReferralReplies, FakeSpecialist) in package io.nxmatic.rke2lab.doctor.testkit, EXPORTED so the sibling doctor-core-test fragment imports them through the doctor-port host (OSGi Core §3.14) — dissolving the old doctor-testkit module. The src/test harness is plain JVM (VSCode-clickable): it boots Felix, attaches this fragment, and proxies each @Test into the container via a JUnit Platform Launcher running in-framework, mapping results to one DynamicTest per test.
